[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (lst: List Int) : Int :=
match lst with
| [] => 0
| head :: tail =>
  if head % 2 = 1 && tail.length % 2 = 0 then
    head + implementation (List.drop tail (tail.length / 2))
  else
    implementation (List.drop lst 2)
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma implementation_drop_even
(lst: List Int)
(i: Nat)
(h_i_lt_len: i < lst.length)
(h_i_even: i % 2 = 0)
: implementation (List.drop lst i) = implementation lst :=
by
induction' lst generalizing i
case nil
simp
case cons head tail ih
have h_drop_head: (head :: tail).drop i = if i = 0 then tail else head :: (tail.drop i) := by
  simp [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_le]
have h_drop_tail_len: (tail.drop i).length = (if i = 0 then tail.length else tail.length - 1) := by
  simp [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_le]
have h_drop_tail_even: (if i = 0 then tail.length else tail.length - 1) % 2 = 0 := by
  simp [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_le, h_drop_tail_len]
by_cases h_i_eq_0: i = 0
-- case i = 0
simp [h_i_eq_0]
simp [h_drop_head, h_drop_tail_len]
simp [ih]
-- case i > 0
simp [h_i_eq_0]
have h_i_gt_0: i > 0 := by
  linarith
have h_i_odd: i % 2 = 1 := by
  linarith
have h_drop_head': (head :: tail).drop i = head :: tail.drop i := by
  simp [h_i_gt_0]
simp [h_drop_head', h_drop_head, h_drop_tail_len]
simp [h_i_even, h_drop_tail_even, h_i_odd, ih]
[END]
